name: com.tencent.timpush.vivo.VIVOPushMessageReceiverImpl
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Vivo adapter receives callbacks when a Vivo push notification is clicked or a registration ID arrives; its code records those events without forwarding message content.
disableEffect: This adapter no longer receives Vivo click or registration callbacks; its code does not change notification content.
